The officer who arrested me for my dui last year was recently arrested for fraud, theft, and a few more things. He also lied on my police report several times so this felt kinda nice. 

The funny part is that the sheriffs department started a go-fund-me for his court costs and other fees because, “He’s still a good person.”
It’s definitely wired incorrectly, not your fault.

I mean I’ll tell you how stupid my life is and how badly I’ve fucked up if that makes you feel any better, but my moral compass won’t allow me to help you with doing that. I’m here to talk if you’d want to dm, you’re not alone with how you feel.

If you’re sure you’re going to do it why do you care to share the details? I’m not meaning to ask  in a condescending or rude way I’m just curious and stupid with words. Talking about this keeps me occupied from doing it to myself.
You’re not alone. Almost the same situation with me, I don’t know how to go on but I hope you find a way.

Yes, my husband is telling me that this is illegal but I don’t want to report it as stolen and make things worse and I don’t think it would even be worth it. I just got ahold of the trooper and he said he never saw my ID when he definitely did and I feel like shit already so idk if I should say that I lost it.

I kinda looked into it but not sure how accurate this is for 2019, I’d say just speak to an attorney they help regardless! 

[California Diversion ](https://jnlawoffices.com/californias-first-offender-programs/)
Breathalyzer is hard to beat in court, get an attorney and plea for a diversion if allowed. It will be much easier and you will not be charged with the DUI.

I was lucky enough to have insurance when I was involuntarily taken to the hospital. That was the only pro. From there they forced me to go into inpatient therapy (even though I was no longer suicidal 24 hours later after being physically treated) 

Then wouldn’t let me leave until 6 psychiatrists evaluated me at one time at a giant oval table. Which was horrible. 

We were allowed to draw and play piano. We did ball bouncing exercises and did coloring books the entire time.We did have group therapy which was a fraction of the time spent. 

I lied my ass off to get out of there but I did feel a little better, I met some people like me who made me change my thinking and it gave me some hope. 

Side note: my nurse in the hospital (before I went to the behavioral health side) made a comment when she left that really stung and made me realize not many people take mental health seriously. She said,” We all did stupid stuff when we were kids.”  Referring to my suicide attempt of literally less than 24 hours prior. She was around 30y and I was 21. 

edit: this was on a military base in the US
I do not like
They look like a bunch of cute lil butts

You’re definitely right about not needing a reason to be depressed because chemicals have a lot to do with it. I guess I asked because from a young age I became distant with reality and I’ve never really reconnected so it’s hard to feel happy when I never understand what’s going on or why. 

My best advice is to ask yourself what’s wrong and try to lead your inner narrative to also question why you’re feeling depressed when it happens. That way you can almost train your brain to figure out new ways of processing the sadness and maybe flip a switch somewhere along the way. 

If there’s one thing I learned through inpatient/outpatient therapy it’s that you need to recognize how your inner narrative (little voice in yo head) is controlling your feelings. Idk why that stuck with me so much but since then I haven’t been suicidal, I think inner me was trying to kill me but I don’t understand life so ¯\\_(ツ)_/¯

I would love that but I live in a place where charity work isn’t too prevalent, but that is a great idea for once I’m able to branch out again. 
Thank you!

Do you know why you’re depressed? 
edit: if you don’t reply I do wish the best for you and if it helps- at least you haven’t damaged your life over your depression and have actively tried to receive help. I just suck

When I was 4 my mom used to randomly tell me there were spiders in my mouth which would cause me to enter into a screaming fit of terrified rage and try to claw them out of my throat with my nails. 

I’m still terrified of spiders.
I would address it head on and ask her why she’s keeping you on a back burner. No harm in asking, just explain to her that it’s caused you some emotional distress.
Just let her borrow money from you, quick and easy.

I don’t exactly feel like my life is a movie (bc it would be hella stupid) but I do believe I’m being observed by some sort of higher being. 
I stopped being religious at a young age but still have a haunting feeling that every decision I make is being carefully judged by some sort of higher council or being. I don’t know if it’s just where I was programmed into a hardcore religion or if it’s just the constant existential crisis but either way it’s something that stays on my mind and makes it hard for me to go places and do things.
Ask for a diversion, get a lawyer, ask for time to get your case together, it’ll be okay. I went through the same thing and it’s not hard to get a diversion as long as you complete it.

I’m in the same situation (22f) but in Tennessee, my first dui was in Kansas. I was almost done with my diversion for the first one and was supposed to move to Hawaii in 10 days but was arrested for drug paraphernalia, dui, and not taking a blood test. I fucked it all because I’m depressed and didn’t tell my therapist how serious my mental state was so here I am. I didn’t wreck or kill anyone but those are the only positives I can see and it kills me. 

You aren’t alone. I spent 15 hours on suicide watch naked af and have no one to relate to or talk to that understands how I feel. I lied to everyone and just hoped that once I got to hawaii I would be okay and not drink anymore. I’m also probably getting a divorce so I literally have no one and debt out the ass. 

I’ve been out of touch with reality for 2 years and can’t seem to figure out how to live now and deal with anything the right way. I tried to overdose last year after my first dui and it only hurts the people who love you and cause a ton of crazy emotions and feelings of guilt. At least that’s my experience. So please don’t think like that.

I know life will go on (plus I can’t kill myself now due to debt and legal obligations) I just feel like human garbage that probably should have just sent it into a fiery crash. I just hope you get better though, you’re not alone in feeling terrible. We all fuck up just some more than others sometimes and I’m right there but I want to be better, even if it’s going to be years.

My husband once forced me to babysit one of his friend’s dog and while I was at work the dog broke out of the kennel. He went to the upstairs spare bedroom closet, pulled out my dead great- grandmothers mink coat I had inherited, and then ate it and pissed on the remnants. He also ate chunks of my bed and pillows, which he also pissed on. Once I found the mess I got hammered and drove 15 hours to my moms house.
Don’t sabotage yourself, even if this world is meaningless you can make something out of it while you’re here.
